The installed geometry reference uses published specifications for a six-segment, windowless, sample-facing EDS arrangement: >4.45 sr unshadowed and 4.04 sr with the analytical double-tilt holder. Public sources do not provide segment area, sensor distance, active-face shape, collimator aperture or package dimensions. Published XPAD work confirms that approximately 4.1-4.6 sr performance required a jointly designed detector, low-penumbra holder and custom objective pole piece. A published instrument report and the inspected user dataset support six signals/segments. FEI multi-detector patents support sample-facing detectors within the TEM objective-lens region only at family/topology level. The symmetric azimuth phase and physical drawing size are non-OEM schematics pending user cross-sections.
User-specified square engineering representation, 2026-10-20; not a measured OEM active-face or package shape. Angular X-ray acceptance remains independently defined in EDS.toml.

The seat floor is Z=-0.05 mm; no grid thickness or separate grid solid is inferred. Retraction translates this mechanical holder along +X only and does not change sample.inserted or crystal orientation.
Holder sits in the side-entry stage guide; tip passes through the pole gap. Explicit material geometry, not its axial envelope, establishes clearance.

User-authorized simulator opening, 2026-09-08. A 6 mm radius clears the 168.8 mrad coherent HAADF support of the Si scan with radial margin in the ordinary nanoprobe/diffraction preset (DPA angular transfer about 32.26 mm/rad). Its DPA-limited upper angle is about 186 mrad; full 60-330 mrad collection still requires the saved DPA-crossover lens setting. The 0.2 mm literature reference is retained separately. Differential-pumping performance is not modelled.

Public microscope manuals place a differential-pumping aperture between the column and projection chamber and document a 200 micrometre reference opening. The user selected a 0.2 mm plate thickness to match the other simulator apertures on 2026-10-07; this is a model parameter, not an OEM measurement. The zero-length layout row preserves the interface reference plane; the physical plate uses plate_thickness_mm about that plane.
